remediationSummary.primaryBlocker: Mandatory provider verification tuple, zero memory-order fallback on database failure in Supabase mode, test mode isolation, durable-only payment crediting

threeCtRequirements.detail: In real/provider payment verification mode, razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, and razorpay_signature are strictly mandatory. Missing attributes fail closed immediately (400) with zero wallet credit.

threeCtRequirements.requirement: 2. Zero Memory Fallback After DB Failure in Supabase Mode
threeCtRequirements.detail: When isSupabaseConfigured === true, any failure to persist to or retrieve from PostgreSQL fails closed (500 DATABASE_ERROR or 400 PAYMENT_ORDER_NOT_FOUND). It never falls back to in-memory order creation or verification.
In-memory orders registry is strictly isolated to test/offline mode when isSupabaseConfigured === false.
